description: This file defines an Android activity named ProductDetailActivity, which displays detailed information about a product passed via intent extras. It also allows the user to add the product to the shopping cart. The activity interacts with ViewModel classes to retrieve product data and update the cart.

classes.name: ProductDetailActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays product details and provides an option to add the product to the shopping cart.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the onCreate method of AppCompatActivity to set up the activity UI, retrieve product information via ViewModel, and handle add-to-cart actions.
